scripts.dev: node scripts/wrangler/build-config.ts --env development && vp dev --host localhost --port 6173 --strictPort
scripts.build: node scripts/wrangler/build-config.ts --env development && tsc && vp build
scripts.build:production: node scripts/wrangler/build-config.ts --env production && tsc && vp build
scripts.deploy:production: vp run build:production && vp run db:migrate:production && vp exec wrangler deploy
scripts.cf-typegen: node scripts/wrangler/build-config.ts --env development && vp exec wrangler types
scripts.db:migrate:local: node scripts/wrangler/build-config.ts --env development && vp exec wrangler d1 migrations apply context-kit-local --local
scripts.db:migrate:production: node scripts/wrangler/build-config.ts --env production && vp exec wrangler d1 migrations apply context-kit-production --remote --yes
